about: Demonstration images for PathScribe's seed row S10. Copy to manifest.json next to index.html once the images are converted. Every entry records its source and licence; the same text goes in previews/<slide>.licence.txt beside its preview. Fill in the exact file names and read each licence before use (docs/product/SLIDE_IMAGE_DEMO.md).

S26-5404-B1-L1.title: Sentinel lymph node, H&E (no metastasis)
S26-5404-B1-L1.source: CAMELYON16, a normal lymph node slide (record the file name), Radboud University Medical Center and University Medical Center Utrecht, via the AWS Open Data registry
S26-5404-B1-L1.note: Openly licensed research image, shown for demonstration.

S26-5404-C1-L1.title: Sentinel lymph node, H&E (metastatic carcinoma)
S26-5404-C1-L1.source: CAMELYON16, a tumour slide (record the file name), via the AWS Open Data registry
S26-5404-C1-L1.note: Openly licensed research image, shown for demonstration.

S26-5404-C1-L2.title: Sentinel lymph node, H&E recut (failed image quality)
S26-5404-C1-L2.source: A blurred copy of the S26-5404-C1-L1 image, made for the demonstration (Gaussian blur, recorded in SLIDE_IMAGE_DEMO.md)
S26-5404-C1-L2.note: Deliberately blurred to show a slide that failed the image quality check.

S26-5404-A1-L1.title: Breast, mastectomy, H&E
S26-5404-A1-L1.source: To choose: an OpenSlide test image or a TCIA collection, only after its licence has been read
S26-5404-A1-L1.note: Leave this entry out until the licence is confirmed; PathScribe then shows the preview template's image only.

S26-5402-A1-L1.title: Breast, wide local excision, whole-mount H&E
S26-5402-A1-L1.source: A further CAMELYON16 slide, or an immunostain from an openly licensed collection once its licence is read
S26-5402-A1-L1.licence: CC0 1.0 for CAMELYON16 (confirm on the dataset page)
S26-5402-A1-L1.note: Openly licensed research image, shown for demonstration.
